foods.name: Bánh canh bột gạo đã luộc, để ráo
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: USDA168914 cooked rice noodles was already rejected: thickness/hydration and rice/tapioca formulation unknown. INMU158 Vietnamese noodles does not identify banh canh formulation.
foods.evidence_needed: Identify rice-only product or rice/tapioca ratio and measured cooked/drained yield; complete label or quantified recipe.

foods.name: Thịt bò thăn nạc luộc chín, không sốt
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: MEXT11267 is boiled crossbred fillet but18g fat/100g, not a demonstrated lean tenderloin. INMU has round boiled or raw tenderloin, not the needed cut/state.
foods.evidence_needed: Cooked lean tenderloin source with cut/trim and edible yield; do not reuse raw meat or fatty fillet unchanged.

foods.name: Thịt heo nạc băm hấp chín, không dầu
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: INMU971 minced boiled pork has14.8g fat, not lean steamed mince; dry pan-broiled96%lean USDA168375 is not steamed.
foods.evidence_needed: Define fat proportion and steam yield/drained losses, or exact cooked lean-mince source.

foods.name: Tôm thẻ luộc chín, bóc vỏ
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: USDA175180 cooked shrimp omits fiber, so available carbs cannot be total-minus-missing. INMU1044 is Penaeus monodon (giant tiger), not whiteleg; source171971 may contain moisture additives.
foods.evidence_needed: Whiteleg cooked peeled same-record dietary fiber/carbohydrate definition; no borrowing a zero from another species/record.

foods.name: Thịt/riêu cua đồng nấu chín, lọc sạch vỏ
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: Whole raw freshwater crab, sea crab and filtered cooked crab curd are different edible fractions; no defensible conversion/yield found in reviewed sources.
foods.evidence_needed: Named freshwater species, filtering/extraction process, shell discard, curd/final edible mass and nutrients or quantified recipe.

foods.name: Sả tươi băm, phần lõi ăn được
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: USDA168573 lacks fiber; INMU237 correctly identifies Cymbopogon citratus but also lacks dietary fiber and available carbs. NIN energy1kcal inconsistent and not used.
foods.evidence_needed: Compatible raw edible-core source with actual total dietary fiber; no4/4/9 reconstruction or missing-to-zero.

foods.name: Bạc hà/dọc mùng, phần thân đã tước vỏ
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: NIN raw peeled giant-taro stem supplies partial macros, but carbohydrate/fiber definition remains unclear and fat absent. No compatible cooked/leaf replacement accepted.
foods.evidence_needed: Exact Colocasia/Leucocasia edible stem identity with raw peeled100g basis and dietary-fiber definition.

foods.name: Rau ngổ sống
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: NIN rice-paddy herb partial record lacks fat/usable carbs/fiber. No reviewed exact raw Limnophila aromatica complete record.
foods.evidence_needed: Raw edible herb record with assay-defined fiber/available carbohydrate, not dry extract/herbal pharmacology data.

foods.name: Ngò gai sống
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: INMU499 identifies Eryngium foetidum and supplies41kcal/protein/fat but leaves carbs/fiber blank. NIN parsley identity is not used.
foods.evidence_needed: Culantro raw same-state available carbs/dietary fiber. Do not fill by parsley or derive available carbs without fiber.

foods.name: Nước dùng heo thành phẩm, không nêm
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: MEXT17025 is mixed chicken/pork/vegetable stock, not unsalted pork stock. USDA beef/chicken stock concentration is not transferable.
foods.evidence_needed: Quantified pork-only stock recipe, fat-removal/dilution, final consumed yield or specific product label.

foods.name: Dầu điều màu thành phẩm
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: Filtered annatto oil composition depends on carrier oil, seed infusion/filtering and retained solids; no quantified matching formulation/label reviewed.
foods.evidence_needed: Carrier oil type, input/filtered output mass, retained solids or identified complete product label.

foods.name: Hành phi thành phẩm
foods.reviewed_rejection_or_gap: No matching fried-shallot complete source. Raw shallot is not fried shallot; breaded fried onion differs. Oil absorption and dehydration dominate values.
foods.evidence_needed: Identified fried-shallot label or measured raw shallot/oil/edible final yield with defined absorbed oil.
